items.text: Medical Coding Is a Real, Medical coding is a real, certification-based, growing career in India, not a filler job with no ceiling.

items.heading: "Medical Coding Salary in India"
items.text: "Medical coding salary in India" is close to a meaningless single number, because the spread between a first-year trainee and an established coding manager or HIM director is enormous, and most institute marketing quotes only the flattering end of it.

items.heading: Institute Ads Lean on "Become
items.text: Institute ads lean on "become a medical coder in weeks," "US healthcare job, no MBBS needed," and "work from home", the fast, painless version of the story that pulls life-sciences and general graduates toward a certification course.

items.heading: Placement
items.text: Placement-day stories about the rare coder who moves into a specialty coding role or a remote arrangement circulate widely, while the far more common first year, an evening-to-night shift, a strict daily chart quota, and an accuracy target, barely gets mentioned.

items.heading: Very Little Course Marketing Explains
items.text: Very little course marketing explains that passing the CPC exam without two years of coding experience only earns a CPC-Apprentice (CPC-A) tag, and clearing that apprentice status usually takes real logged experience or extra continuing-education units, not just the exam pass.
